$comment: The one place this registry instance is named. Every IRI prefix, host name and site label the build, the meta-schema, the templates and the worker use comes from here. To run your own registry, change these values and the `name` in wrangler.toml; nothing else in the repository carries an instance-specific value (CI fails if one appears). See README.md, 'Running your own registry'.
